body: Adversarial review round 13 (codex, high): website/content/docs/reference/cli/doctor.mdx has a markdown table row on line 2, inside the YAML frontmatter, left by an earlier edit; it breaks the page. The Model catalog row already lives in website/content/docs/getting-started/verify.mdx, which doctor.mdx points to for every check id. Delete the stray line so the frontmatter is only title and description, regenerate with cd website && npm run gen and confirm no generated diff, and check the page parses (frontmatter is valid YAML). Acceptance: frontmatter valid; npm run gen leaves website/generated unchanged; npm test green.
title: Remove the Model catalog row wrongly inserted into doctor.mdx frontmatter
